placement.heading_direction: Model +z follows long nave axis toward the northeast; entrance faces southwest. Bearing comes from the production mapped straight nave side.
placement.ground_evidence: Production center 114.339 m; retained samples inside the temple/entrance bounds range 114.210–114.640 m. No flat pad or lowered terrain is authored.
placement.exclusion: Convex triangulation of synagogue way 223530620, each piece inset 1.5% toward its centroid to avoid shared boundaries. Museum 385832061, Heroes Temple 223530623 and the courtyard arcades retain source geometry. No road suppression.

dimensional_qualification.implementation: The published 53.1 by 26.5 m controls the long rear body. Mapped separate western foyer and oblique entrance wings add to overall complex length. This interpretation does not resolve the source disagreement; the 56.5 m mapped rear length is retained in provenance and activation ownership.
dimensional_qualification.reason: Whole-complex feature height conflicts with published 26 m interior and 43.6 m towers.

estimated_secondary_geometry.scope: Heights below the documented finial, roof slope, window spacing, voussoir counts, brick-band pitch and ornamental offsets are photograph-derived estimates rather than surveyed fabric. Roof metal type is not asserted. No interior, separate museum, Heroes Temple, courtyard monuments or invented lettering is modeled.
